calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-18-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, Proceedings reported by: Sonia Wong, CSR#11288.
Petitioners Caho Ping Liu and Mei Yin Cho; father and mother of minor present in court.
Petitioners sworn and examined through Cantonese Interpreter Baoyu Huang.
Proof of Publication on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Wilson Yaoqi Cho to Wilson Yaoqi Liu.
The court also grantes the petition for Change of Name of Mei Yin Cho (mother of minor) to Jenny Meiyin Cho.
Decree Changing Names signed in open court.

decreed_name: Wilson Yaoqi Liu; Jenny Meiyin Cho
